## 4e9b5d003ae7

**Finding AUD-4E9-1 — advertised decoy control is dead.** Generator SHA-256
`b4c6904c11fe6be11910e175b4afbd09d6885e453913f3d5210a4c5b9111f72a`;
selected rule hash `e6d28cb0c8db`. With seed 123, sample index 7, difficulty
`medium`, the default draw and `include_decoy=true` produce byte-identical inputs
(SHA-256
`5946d5dea78c594727627d5368570bc96d5c50535c0bc35cc10010f90542f20c`).
Both pass `self_check` and are in the documented generated domain. The selected
Racket authority returns identical valid outputs (SHA-256
`f4b17e498d042065c641b8e0b3fd7a96d59b256647a0df1d2752eca43151d32a`).

Reproducer with actual and alternate-control/rival outputs:
`checks/audit/4e9b5d003ae7/counterexample.json`. Raw apply record:
`checks/audit/4e9b5d003ae7/racket.json`.

The lint stage independently fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing, and the
semantic gate is advisory because the generator declares no executable rivals or
witnesses. Evidence: `checks/audit/4e9b5d003ae7/lint.run.log` and
`checks/audit/4e9b5d003ae7/semantic_gate.run.log`. I did not claim a complete
override matrix for this target; only the direct paired intervention was run.

**Impact.** A curriculum builder may believe it sampled decoy-bearing examples
when it did not, reducing effective diversity and hiding a missing teaching
branch. No fix was made because this is an audit-only target.

## 4e9b5d003ae7

**Finding AUD-4E9-2 — the prior dead-decoy finding generalizes to three dead
boolean axes; unknown controls are also accepted.** I did not modify this audit
target. This confirms and broadens retained finding `AUD-4E9-1` on the same
current source.

Current generator SHA-256:
`b4c6904c11fe6be11910e175b4afbd09d6885e453913f3d5210a4c5b9111f72a`.
Selected rule hash: `e6d28cb0c8db`.

Across 120 same-seed pairs per axis (40 indices in each difficulty), toggling
`anchor_corner`, `asymmetry_force`, or `include_decoy` produced byte-identical
inputs in **120/120 pairs for every axis**. All 720 generated grids passed
`self_check`. An undeclared `definitely_unknown_axis=123` override was accepted
and ignored. The exact seed-123/sample-7 medium `include_decoy=false/true` pair
is byte-identical, and the supported Racket authority returns the same valid
output (input SHA-256 `5946d5de…20c`, output SHA-256 `f4b17e49…32a`).

Evidence: `checks/audit/4e9b5d003ae7/control-probe.json`, `input.json`, and
`racket.json`. The older retained audit under the target's `counterexamples/`
already records the single `include_decoy` intervention; this run adds the two
other inert controls and a 120-pair-per-axis denominator.

**Impact.** The advertised curriculum branches cannot be sampled, making axis
coverage reports false and hiding absent decoy/asymmetry teaching support.
Recommended repair: remove all three axes unless concrete semantics are defined,
or implement them with exact observable effects; reject unknown overrides and
pin `RULE_HASH`.
